Name: A Breath of Spring Wide Wallpaper
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Wide wallpaper based on Zou Fulei's A Breath of Spring
Description:
_Description_

*   Wide wallpaper based on Zou Fulei's A Breath of Spring
_Quick start instructions_

*   Download and unzip this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder. (If you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)  )

*   Get the wallpaper catalogue from Pierre's shop, the wallpaper from this mod will be listed there

_Mods that work well with this one_

*   Japanese furniture mod (coming soon)
___Notes
_I do [commissions](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart/gallery), I do lots of things from art and map making to mod conversions. Got an idea you want help with? Message me!
